t: Participate in the Chariot race on Dionic Archipelago, the race on Kirah or the marathon on the Wandering Isle and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

Don't you sometimes get bored, when you neither feel like resting nor saving the world? This is when you should try a different kind of entertainment! Like races on Dionic Archipelago or Kirah or marathon on the Wandering Island. Trust me, they are really exciting!

Here is a trial for you - participate in a race or a marathon, and I will reward you with a meteorite fragment. Heroes need their leisure, too!
Find one of the lost in time on Kirah and report to Klim Pisarev.

Oh those daredevils! They wander around Kirah as if it were their home. Getting lost in time there is just as easy as getting lost in its deserts. We need to bring home those who have already got lost!

So, take up this trial - find one of the lost in time on Kirah, and I will reward you with a meteorite fragment!
Help kill 5 players in the Kingdom of Elements or 15 players in Skirmishes and report to Klim Pisarev.

Those who achieve greatness, make great enemies, too. And your enemies are just countless! The Empire is our biggest threat at the moment. We should thin down their ranks, don't you think?

Help us put an end to several enemy lives in the Kingdom of Elements or in Skirmishes, and I will reward you with a meteorite fragment.
Deliver messages to the Servants of the Light and report to Klim Pisarev.

In these dark times, we have to keep our faith stronger than ever! Servants of the Light on most distant allods do their best to keep our warriors in high spirits. But who will encourage the Servants themselves? Poor girls spend years away from their homes, among gloomy and rude soldiers! They need to be cheered up, too.

So here is a trial that will reward you with a meteorite fragment - visit several Servants of the Light and cheer them up. This isn't that hard, is it?
Complete one of the daily quests on Ferris and report to Klim Pisarev.
Ferris is full of mysteries and dangers. Here is your mission: help Surveyors on Ferris, whatever it is they want you to do. I will reward you with a Meteorite Fragment.
Destroy the strongest enemy in any Distortion and report to Klim Pisarev.

Distortion is no place for the weak. When you get there, you will see images of the past - or what it could have been like. You will see all the possible variations of the past events! And you will be the one who decides which one will define the present. A decent challenge for those who pursue Greatness!

So here is your challenge: go to any Distortion and destroy the most dangerous enemy, and I will rewards you with a Meteorite Fragment!
Open a chest on the Melting Isle and report to Klim Pisarev on completion.

Here's a trial for you. If you complete it, I'll reward you with a meteorite fragment. Earn a victory in the Deserted Farm. Yes, that's not going to be easy, since other heroes won't let you win just like that. And that's fair, for only the best of the best, the greatest of the Great will merit an allod of their own!
Defeat one of the powerful enemies in Ancient Mound, Eclipse, "Gates" Project, Fractal, Winter Palace, Battle of Gods, Observatory or Secret Paths. Report to Klim Pisarev.

I am amazed at all the trials you've been through! The fact that you are still alive is not really surprising - the Gift of Tensess hasn't failed anyone on my memory - but I am wondering why do you always face dangers on your own?

There are battles that cannot be won single-handedly. You will need a squad of loyal allies, who will help you fight your greatest enemies!

Here is a trial that will reward with 7 precious meteorite fragments! Gather a party and defeat a power enemy in one of the dungeons.
I hope that you are a respectful apprentice and have a good relationship with your mentor. Otherwise the only reward you will get is the sympathy of demons.
Use the Apprentice's Wand to summon the Spirit of Wisdom and defeat it.

Slow to learn, easy to beat! Remember that, if you don't want to lose your head on the expanses of Sarnaut! In order for you to absorb that simple truth even better, I propose a little test for you, which you can only complete with the help of your mentor. Your reward for this test will be some amazing equipment! I will give you a magic wand. All you will have to do is wave it and an extremely strong spirit will appear before you, your test is to defeat it. Don't even think about trying to defeat it on your own - that would be impossible. Summon your mentor to help, and if they agree to help you, as a trophy you will receive a special Apprentice's Gift. As a sign of respect for your mentor, bestow the power of the gift on them, it will complete your test and you will receive your reward. And remember, that this test is not the only one that I can offer you. As you gain experience, the difficulty of the tests proposed by me will increase, but the rewards will be worth it!
You are progressing well, apprentice. You will not be disappointed with your reward! But your education is not over yet. Come to see me again!
Now your training has been completed. Accept my congratulations!
Bring the family heirloom kept in the Fortress of Darkness back to Vladimir Zalesky.

The House of Zalesky was first mentioned in ancient chronicles of the times when Tensess and Nezeb were fighting against Orcs over these lands.
There were ups and downs. We were rich and poor. The Night of Astral Portals hit us especially hard. Our lands were in the part of Kania which is now overtaken by Astral.
That's when my grandfather sold the family heirloom to the Elves of the House de Desirae to make ends meet. I've always dreamt to have it back and recently I've asked Margaret de Desirae to give it to me. The Lady of Tenebra agreed to satisfy my request, but she never had a chance...
I don't know what happened on Tenebra. Judging by what Margaret de Desirae wrote in her letter, she didn't know, either. One thing is certain. The heirloom is in the castle of the Elves now called the Darkblood Citadel.
Please bring it back to me and then you'll have my guarantee.

In old good times you could be granted a title of nobility without money and protection.
Only for your deeds.

You've done a great deed.
Now I trust you with my life and can stake my life and honor for you.
Go to the Castle Blight, win the Curse and temper in his blood a charmed steel.

All three guarantees are received, and we can proceed with the last task. Most difficult.
I prepared for you a charmed steel. We will try to do for you a tempered weapon.
What do we need for that? Right. The blood of the reduced enemy and than more dangerous enemy, than temper will be more effective.
There is an enemy in the worlds who can suite best for our purpose. I'm talking about the Curse of the Valir Castle. If you can defeat him, then temper a steel in the blood of this bastard.
There is no enemies, more suitable than a Curse of the Valir Castle!

Perfect.
There is a tempered steel!
Talk to Iberian Izbor to choose your reward.

So, everything is ready to make tempered weapons for you.
What do you prefer? Staff? Axe? Rod? Or crossbow?
However, you will have the choice.
Tell me when you can choose your reward.

Now choose!
Sure this weapon will be used only for the good.
Fight the Rebels in the Darkwater to get 4 pages of the ancient treatise "Tempering Weapons" and bring them to Iberian Izbor in Novograd.

In these times a strong blade or magic staff is no longer a rarity. Previously, when the trees were higher, the grass was greener, and the world has been whole, only few could afford this luxury.
When we buy something, we also lose something. Nobles of Kania had a unique ability to temper weapons in the blood of vanquished enemies. Such weapons acquired special properties, but...
This knowledge was believed to be lost. I thought so, too. Then I received a page of the ancient treatise "Tempering Weapons" from Darkwater. It might be possible to recover the lost knowledge.
The page was picked up from the body of one of the slain rebels. A noble. Well, it seems to be genuine. One of the oldest families must know this secret.
I guess you already know what I'm asking for.
Yes, we need to fully restore this treatise. We have one page, so you need to find four more.

What amazing times we live in!
The times when fairytales are coming to life!

Great! Treatise restored! Can't believe that we will be able to restore the ancient knowledge?
Find out now.
Get the guarantees from Sivoyar Zablosky and Vladimir Zalesky than come back to Izbor Yavorsky.

It's not that easy, but at least it is clear what to do next.
Those willing to temper their weapons, should receive three guarantees from the nobles, who have to pledge their honor that they fully trust you, and that your weapons will never be brought against the government. The nobles have always feared rebellion in their own ranks. This never changed.
I'm noble, so I'll give my word, this will be your first guarantee.
You need two more. And I know who you should ask.
The first is Sivoyar Zablosky, the alchemists' trainer. You'll find him here in Novograd. Most likely, you'll have to earn his trust by completing a task.
The other is governor Vladimir Zalesky. He's at the camp in Oreshek, most surely he will make good use of your assistance.
When you have completed their tasks, do come back to me.

What did Sivoyar and Vladimir say?
Will they vouch for you?

Now it's mine.
As I promised, I declare that I l trust you and I'm ready to vouch for you my honor and life.
Alchemist Sivoyar Zablosky needs you to bring him 2 measures of Twilight Spider mucus, 2 skins of Twilight Gargoyles and 2 measures of Dusky Bat bile from the Tenebra island.

This is what we are going to do.

I'll help you, and you'll help me.

I got a special order from the League Defenders. I want to use these ingredients to make a potion that can save our valiant defenders from demons. And you will get them for me. Are you familiar with the term "twilight creatures"? They first appeared on the Tenebra island under strange circumstances. It was the Astral that caused them to change. We can use them to fight against this destructive element.

Bring me two measures of Twilight Spider mucus, two skins of Twilight Gargoyles, and two measures of Dusky Bat bile. And then I'll help you.

Demon Hunters gave me the recipe of this potion.
They use even more peculiar ingredients, though. And they are even harder to get!

That's what we need!
Now with a clear conscience, I can carry out my part of persuasion.
Know that I completely trust you and ready to vouch for you on my honor and life.
Make sure all dancers are ready and return to Father Winter.

Happy New Year to you! Are you having a good time? Excellent! I'm from the New Year Council and it's my job to make sure that people have fun and feel the New Year coming! We've been busy organizing a ton of events and distributing holiday goodies every day.
You can help me a bit, you know.
We are setting up a huge dancing event! To get everybody involved, I arranged Merry Dancers all around Novograd: on the Main Square, in the Trade District, in the Elven and Gibberling Districts. Will you walk around the neighborhood and check if everybody is dancing alright. Let me know, if anyone fails to dance!

Holidays should be highly valued.
The more extensive the celebrations, the better!
Good job! Now the people of Novograd will enjoy the holiday season even more.
Throw 3 Snowballs and return to Father Winter.

Snow and the New Year celebration are inseparable! This tradition stems from the time before the Great Cataclysm when it would get very cold at this time of year. It's been centuries since snow fell from the sky, but does that mean we have to forget about it? No!
The New Year Council has many talented mages making snow night and day. Most of what they make is used to create the best things of all - snowballs! Here, take some samples. You can toss them at your friends - purely for fun. Or you can throw snowballs at your enemies and defeat them before the snow wears off. Repeat it three times, and the holiday gift is yours!
There is also another way to receive the presents. If the New Year begins and people's hearts are only filled with greed, they will become corrupted like Greedy Father Winter. Then they will have only one goal - to ruin the holiday festivities! They'll run all over the city tearing down as many candy canes as possible. The only way to stop them is with snow!
If you find yourself in need of more snowballs, you should take what you need from the snowmen.
Now you know about one of the best ways to spend the holiday - engaging in snowball fights!
Place 5 Holiday Trees, 5 Snowmen, and 5 Candy Canes around Novograd and return to Father Winter.

Novograd is already full of snowmen, candy canes, and holiday trees... but we still need more! Do you think you can help us?
Here, place these trees about the city so people can have more gifts! Set up the snowmen, too - they look mighty fine, and people can grab more snowballs. And these candy canes - I know Greedy Fathers Winters just love tearing them down, but they're so beautiful!
A holiday is nothing without the proper decorations!
Thank you! Everything looks so wonderful, doesn't it?
Dance in three districts of Novograd, fix three snowmen, give presents to three citizens and return to Father Winter.

We’re off schedule! We’re about to fail! Help us organize the celebrations! Will you?

First of all, we need animation. Show them how to dance, so that they would catch up! Dance in three districts under three fir trees.

Second, the snowmen. Throwing snowballs is fun, but it ruins the snowmen! Here’s spare snow, it’s enough to fix holes in three snowmen.

Third, and the main thing, the gifts! Give them to three citizens on my behalf! Don’t worry, I’ll give one to you too!
There are good traditions and best traditions!
Thanks, what would I have done without you. Here’s your reward!
Visit Marina Jidkova in the Central League Camp to find out about the Martyr's Guidance ability!

Are you planning on visiting the Holy Land soon? If you do make sure to visit Marina Jidkova. She's a very wise druid that will help you learn the Martyr's Guidance ability - the next level of connection with your patron!
Make sure you comply with all the instructions she gives you. In times of war every citizen must make themselves as strong as possible. It'll be difficult to fight the Imperials without this power.
Coming to me may be one of the best decisions you ever made. It's extremely important that you learn the Martyr's Guidance ability!
Visit Zosim Nikulin in western Eljune to find out about the Martyr's Protection ability.

Have you ever heard about the great ascetic named Zosim Nikulin? He's a veteran of the Great Astral Campaign and he's very enlightened. They say he's been blessed by Tensess himself!
He's currently living in western Eljune and I would recommend that you seek him out immediately. Not only to see a living saint, but to ask for his help in learning the Martyr's Protection ability.
I'm sure you can tell how much easier life is for those who have earned the third level. Now just imagine the benefits of the fourth! Zosim is possibly the only person enlightened enough to help you with your mission, so go see him immediately!
So you're interested in the Martyr's Protection, eh? Hm... Alright, I'll help you with your task.

Ask Axiniya Zemlemerova to add the coordinates of your personal allod to the portal network, then either speak to any Portal Guardian or use your Adventurer's Stone to teleport to your allod and meet Bob Jackhammer.

Your allod is almost complete! We strengthened the surface with meteorite fragments and changed the landscape as you ordered. And now I'm happy to announce that from now on, a new island is entirely in your possession!  Just tell me when you are ready, and I will add your allod’s coordinates to the global teleportation map so you can travel to your domain using the Adventurer's Stone at any time.
This construction project is wearing me out...
I'm the foreman here, they call me Bob Jackhammer. I'm supervising the construction of your tower!

Just tell me when you are ready, and I will add your allod’s coordinates to the global teleportation map so you can travel to your domain using the Adventurer's Stone at any time.

Just tell me when you are ready, and I will add your allod’s coordinates to the global teleportation map so you can travel to your domain using the Adventurer's Stone at any time.
This construction project is wearing me out...
I'm the foreman here, they call me Bob Jackhammer. I'm supervising the construction of your tower!

Use the extractor on the corpses of slain enemies of at least 70th level to summon their energy bundles, then destroy these bundles to charge the vials containing the iridescence suspension. You'll need the energy of 30 Elementals, 30 humanoids, 30 beasts and 30 Architects, all killed by you on Ammr. Then go back to Sivoyar Zablosky and get a vial of chromatite from him.

Throughout the ages, the highest form of alchemy has always been the ability to produce Amalgam from a solution based on an extremely rare component - the iridescence. It is a very complicated process, and many alchemists have lost their lives attempting to learn the secret of producing Amalgam by alchemical means!

The problem is that the iridescence only reacts with chromatite, a very unstable substance that can explode at any moment. But that's only half the problem.

The hardest part is actually finding a iridescence! But you're not afraid of challenges, are you? Then take a magic extractor and a few vials filled with iridescence suspension, and transform it into a proper iridescence. To do that you'll need to kill a specific creature and absorb its lifeforce with the extractor. You'll need the energy of demons, beasts, elementals and humanoids. Creatures from the Kingdom of Elements will do - the magialchemic environment there is just right!

Simply kill the enemy and wait for its energy bundle to appear, then defeat the bundle.

For completing the quest you'll get some chromatite. Then all you need to do is mix the iridescence and the chromatite at a ratio of 4 to 1 in a mortar. If everything is done correctly, you'll get drops of pure Amalgam as a result!
Once again we see that art requires sacrifice... Especially in the case of alchemy!

Did you manage to get a iridescence? Not a suspension, but a real iridescence, charged with the energy of fallen enemies? Excellent! Then take a flask of chromatite from my personal supplies. It is my gift to you, so be grateful! And try to not blow up the capital...
Speak with Sivoyar Zablosky in Aidenus' Tower.

So you think you can compete with us, huh? Well that's fine by us! Our great nation is brimming with new recruits. Scouts, Pagans, Mystics - they all need leather goods! There's certainly enough work to go around!
We've even got a training book for sale complete with tools. It's not exactly free but not expensive either! All you need to get started is to buy our package!
If that doesn't suit you... You could always try speaking to Sivoyar Zablosky, the alchemy teacher. You'll find him in the Main Square by Aidenus' Tower.

Ah look, another adventurer come to seek Sivoyar's knowledge. If it wasn't for my orders, I would be the richest and sole alchemist in Novograd. Listen closely, because I'm only going to explain this once.
Speak with Vlad Kononov in Aidenus' Tower.

Alchemy... The greatest art! An intricate process of creating magic potions using simple herbs! Our goods can save lives or end it. Can you think of anything more useful? I certainly can't!
If you decide to join the noble brotherhood of alchemists I can sell you everything you need. A training book and tools should be enough to get any new alchemist started.
But if this fine trade isn't for you, seek out Vlad Kononov, the blacksmithing trainer. You'll find him not far from here, by Aidenus' Tower.
Do you want to find out more about the work of a blacksmith?
Speak with the Raw Family in the Gibberling District.

Describe tailoring? How can anyone describe a sunrise? How can anyone describe a dancing girl? They must be seen.
However, I will say something. My main clients are mages and summoners, who need freedom, not defense, to fight. And believe me, they are all sharp dressers and don't want to wear rags! Only us tailors can solve this very important issue!
I am not afraid of competition, like some of my colleagues. And I freely sell a manual and instruments. If you will resolve to study this craft, you will need to buy them from me.
However, if you don't like tailoring, then talk to other schoolmasters. For example, Raw family, who are experts in tanning hides. You can find them in the Gibberling District.

Well, hello! How's life?
Want to find out more about tanning? We can tell you a lot!
Speak with Valentina de Ardeur in the Elven District.

Attention, everyone!

Novograd Construction Council needs you! We need your skills! We need the best of the best... I'm so tired of yelling this!  No amount of training can make it any less tolerable.

So here's the deal. Our city needs Masters. With a capital M! Tailors, leatherworkers, blacksmiths, weaponsmiths, alchemists - everyone! By order of Aidenus himself, I call on everyone here to go into training with one of our Masters.

You simply need to pick a craft you like. What do you need to do? Talk to the Master Trainers and choose the one you like best. You should start with Valentina de Ardeur, a Tailor Trainer. You can find her in the Elven District in Novograd.

But don't buy textbooks just yet. First speak with all the trainers. Then make your choice. Remember, you can learn only one profession! If you want to get a second one, you'll have to work hard and earn respect among the Masters and Suppliers of Novograd. You can also purchase a license from the Boutique.

However, if you already know which craft you want to learn, tell me about it, and I'll give you a task from the appropriate master. I'll also give you a proper manual and a tool - for a symbolic sum of 50 silver coins. It will cost you more than if you went directly to the masters, but the difference goes to the League's treasury.

Are you here about the apprenticeship?
Let's talk.
Speak with the leader of the League Crafters' Guild, Lela de Ardeur, in Aidenus' Tower.

Are you interested in becoming a blacksmith? You want to learn to make armor for warriors, healers, and paladins? Hmm... Well, I'm required to teach anyone who wants to learn. But you should know that blacksmithing is one of the most strenuous professions there is! Trust me, your muscles will ache after the first day! Well, if you decide to go through with it just let me know. I can sell you the proper training manual and all of the tools you'll need. Right now you should probably visit Lela de Ardeur. She's the leader of the League Artisans' Guild. You'll go to her for all of your orders, so it would be good for you to get to know her.

Yes? Who are you? Oh, you're a potential new artisan, eh? I hope you spoke with all of the craftsmen in town. You did? Good.
If you choose to join our ranks, I am the one who you will report to for your orders. And trust me, there are a lot of them! So make sure you pick a profession that you like - you'll be toiling away at it quite often.

Blacksmithing! Trust me, that's a true art! Brandishing a hammer like a moron won't do: you'll break your fingers and ruin the materials! Yet if you do everything properly... All who wear plate armor - healers, warriors and paladins - will line up and beg for your service! Of course, there are more important things than that...
Anyhow, if you decide to become a blacksmith, talk to me. I have all that you need to get started, both the manual and the tools. And I'll sell them at a good price!
Now, go talk to Zoritsa Kovaleva, the weaponsmith trainer. If you don't want to forge shields, maybe you'll handle blades.

These are tough times. Times when the League has only two allies: an army of heroes and an astral fleet. The fleet is being taken care of by the Astral Academy boys, and we weaponsmiths provide for the army. Some need swords, others axes, others crossbows, others magic wands. Everyone needs a weaponsmith to be friends with: neither fighters nor spellcasters can do without them. Join us: both the League and you will benefit for it!
Speak with Lovewise Catfish, the Keeper of Secrets, in Aidenus' Tower.

Thanks to you, another mystery has been solved! Now, we can use the power of the ancient June people to move between allods.
I suggest you go see Lovewise Catfish, the Keeper of Secrets. He's located in Aidenus' Tower. His job involves collecting, classifying, and studying the ancient mysteries of the world. There's so much that we have yet to discover! He may even reward you for your hand in solving yet another puzzle!
Lovewise Catfish, nice to meet you. How may I help you?

Ancient June magic... A ton of research needs to be done on this immediately. We have many surprises in store for us, that's for sure!
If you are able to uncover any other secrets, come to me and I'll reward you well.
As for the one you've already worked out... Being able to use the ancient teleportation trails is reward enough!
Speak with the Stepan Ukhanov at the Construction Council.

It really is an amazing story... We already knew about the destruction of Clement's Tower, but now the identity of the culprit has been revealed as well.
I'm not surprised, for rebellions have been flaring all across Kania. Even Oreshek Fortress, located right here in Lightwood, has recently been captured. Someone is pulling at the strings of a giant cobweb that entangles all of Kania! I wish I could reach the spider that's controlling it...
And I hear you've solved the mysteries of some ancient June technology? At least there's some good news in the midst of all these troubles! These Meteorite... or, what did you call it? These Adventurer's Stones will revolutionize travel in Kania!
All of Clement's stones will be distributed to the people immediately, and many mages are now frantically searching for more! They've even started trying to imbue the ancient magic into new Stones to create more!
If you want to continue to serve your country you can go visit the Novograd Construction Council. Their tasks might be a bit more mundane than your previous adventures, but they're always in need of dependable people. Building a new capital is no Gibberling sized task!

Don't let that bureaucrat drown you in empty talk. Tell him to do his own work instead of flapping his gums.
Whoops, I'm sorry. I've mistaken you for someone else. So many things to do, so little time. What can I do for you?
So, you want to serve your country? If that's the case then you came to the right place.
Speak with Maya Korchakova at the inn.

Ah, a new face! Just who I was waiting for! I am Vera Shilova of the League Defenders. They're the League's guardians, the elite, the best of the best! We used to focus on battling the demons, but now that the demonic threat has been neutralized, we take care of many things.
For example, we greet newcomers to Kania. We are happy to see you, a citizen of the League, at the gates of our new capital! Welcome to Novograd!
There are many things going on in Kania and you can do your part by helping with the city's construction and addressing a number of other challenges facing our homeland.
We encourage all citizens to contact the Construction Council which is in need of volunteers. We also suggest you visit the Gibberling and Elven embassies where your services might also be required.
Are we all clear? Good. For your first good deed I would suggest you visit the inn. The innkeeper, Maya Korchakova, is a good friend of mine.
She just recently learned that her husband has died. Unfortunately we are at war, and such is the nature of the beast! The dear widow may need your help, so please lend her a hand!

Vera sent you? What a kind soul she is! Don't look at me! I look awful - my eyes are all puffy from crying, my makeup is running... I'm having a tough time right now. My husband has just died.
Sometimes it just gets to me and then I'm nothing but a flood of tears. See, it's about to start again!
Has Vsemil sent you? That's right on time.
Speak with Dobrinya Letov at the Eastern Sawmill.

Boo hoo hoo, why did you leave me? My darling! My breadwinner!
I'm sorry. Living through a loved one's death is not an easy experience. I only saw him once in a blue moon but he was still loved. It's a pity.
What should I do now? I don't know how to survive alone! I need someone to support me in my times of need! It has to be someone sensible, wise, and consistent - someone reliable. I have an eye on one such man. His name is Dobrinya, the Sawmill Manager. He's a very intense person.
You know, if someone were to go there and tell him that my hubby's dead, I'd be really grateful. Do you mind?
What? A new order from the Council? Again? Oh, you're here about a personal matter.
Zaya's husband is dead? Hmm, this is troubling news indeed. Of course I'm sorry for the captain, he was a good man and I've wronged him. What is this old fool to do?
Tell Maya Korchakova about Dobrinya Letov's refusal.

Alright, I'm sorry that you had to be part of all this, but could you just deliver my words to the innkeeper? I'll be straight to the point.
Tell her, "Dearest Maya. As you are clearly in deep mourning over the loss of your most respected spouse, I can no longer foresee us continuing with our... hm... most intimate of personal relationships.
As you know, my work is very time consuming and I am unsure whether I'll ever be able to see you again. I advise you to look for... a suitable benefactor somewhere else. This should not be a problem for a lady as... renowned as yourself.
Do not worry about me, Maya. I can manage to... chop my own firewood. Your far, faraway friend, Dobrinya."
I believe you understand what I'm saying here. Let her find her meal ticket somewhere else. And you can tell her that too!
So, what did my dear Dobrinya tell you? When should I expect him to come?
Did he really say that? That bastard! I hope a tree falls on him and that damned sawmill! After everything we had...
Kill 4 Hungry Mites at the Eastern Sawmill and report to Dobrinya Letov.

Let's see what kind of job we can find for you. It shouldn't be too hard - see how many requests I have? Let's pick one at random so you can get right on it!
Now, what do we have here? Oh yes, this one's been collecting dust for ages. The sawmill manager has asked for us to send someone reliable. It seems he wants someone to eliminate the mites that are eating his lumber.
Well, no wonder that's been happening - they've chopped down all the trees! Those mites have families to feed too.
You can begin at once. The sawmill is to the east and there's a prominent road leading out there, so you shouldn't lose your way. Report to sawmill manager Dobrinya Letov when you're done.
Oh yes, I remember. The request from the sawmill manager to eliminate the mites. So, how are you doing?
Very well. I'll mark this request as complete. How about taking on another one?
Plant 4 Druid's Seeds in the Fertile Soil. Report to Stepan Pimenov.

You can't make an omelet without breaking a few eggs or build a city without chopping down a few trees. But wood chips don't grow into new trees by themselves, that's for sure.
I'm a druid, a guardian of nature. Like an injured tree bursts forth resin and sap, my heart bursts into tears when I see the scandalous deeds of these lumberjacks.
Nobody thinks about the future! They all live from day to day. Do they think about what we're going to use for building one hundred years from now? No, none of them!
Only the Green Peace druids do. We are an organization of druids that care about maintaining the balance of nature, and I am one of its representative.
Here, take these seeds. My request is a simple one - plant the seeds in piles of fertile soil, wait a hundred years, and bang - you'll have a beautiful tree to admire. The sooner you start, the earlier you get the results. Once you've planted all the seeds, come back to me for a generous reward.
There are three things a druid must do in his life - plant a tree, nurse an animal, and build a home. I'm currently at stage one.

These trees will grow here in honor of the Green Peace! By the way, don't forget to tell everyone about our new organization. We've only just started our activities, or, to put it more accurately, I've only just started my activities...
But in the future, Green Peace will be a huge success! Oho, such great things will be done! Oh yes, I almost forgot - here's your well-deserved reward!
Distribute the Druid's Potion to 4 Sickly Lumberjacks and return to Stepan Pimenov.

Look around! What do you see? A chopped down forest, trampled fields, and hungry mites. What's the punishment for all this? Death!
No, I'm not kidding. Already some of the lumberjacks have fallen ill. They were bitten by mites. These mites carry any number of diseases and are capable of spreading them across all of Lightwood.
It makes me weep to see this. Though the lumberjacks have brought this upon themselves, I cannot ignore it.
I have a certain potion that has wonderful healing powers. Distribute it to the sickly lumberjacks and soon they will recover. Perhaps this will teach them a good lesson, and in gratitude they will start defending our forests instead.
Healing power of nature is the basis of druid magic!
Well, the potions have been distributed to the sick. All we can do now is wait until it kicks in, hopefully healing not just their bodies, but their souls too!
Bring 4 pieces of Wild Boar Meat to Stepan Ukhanov. You can find the boars in Amberwood.

A new request! Who wants a new request? Aha, we've got a volunteer! This is an army contract, extra high priority. A new military unit has been sent to Oreshek Fortress, but nobody bothered to think about bringing provisions. How are they going to attack the fortress on empty stomachs?
Amberwood hasn't yet been touched by the lumberyard - it's home to many bears and boars. We won't be needing the bears just yet, but we could use some boar meat. Pork is the soldiers' favorite. Go there and don't come back without enough to feed an army!
I wonder what those poor hungry soldiers will say when they learn their dinner is still running around in the forest? I'd love to hear them!
Very well, the request has been fulfilled. I should have joined the army. A soldier's always well fed and happy. If he's alive, of course.
Kill 4 Wild Bears in Amberwood. Report to Dobrinya Letov.

It looks like we'll soon have nothing to chop down in this part of the forest. Look, there are no trees, only stumps.

I've been considering moving the sawmill south for a while, but we need someone to get rid of beasts first. I don't want a repeat of the last time we moved - two of my men were killed by bears!

So, will you help me? Killing four bears should do it. If I file a request with the Construction Council, it'll be a long wait while they process it. We just can't delay this - we have a capital to build!
My father was hunting bears with his bare hands! I'm sure you are equipped way better.
Great! Once we are done here, we will move the sawmill to the south.
Gather 5 Bundles of Asters and bring them to the Gray Family.

Several years ago we sent our best scouts to search for our homeland, a beautiful allod named Isa that my people were forced to leave. Getting home is our main objective. Ton the Windblower's expedition was thought to be extremely promising, but now we've received this heartbreaking news!
Well, let's not get dejected. Some of the scouts have not yet reported back. If they can't find our promised land either, well, we can always send more. The Astral is large and has plenty of elbow room.
By the way, we're running low on asters. These flowers are delicate, and we don't trust the Council's rough hands with gathering them. Will you take the job?
Asters are a kind of flower that are very useful in Astral journeys. Don't even bother asking us what's so special about them. It's a great Gibberling secret. Please go to Amberwood in the east and pick five of them for us.
Have you gathered the flowers for us yet?
Hurray! It's nice being given flowers, even if it's all about business.
Meet Matvey Shramov at the Lake Tract.

Are you the one that's been helping us out so much lately? Great! I've got some news for you. I can't tell if it's good or bad - it's anyone's guess with those detectives.
You see, the investigatory branch of the Construction Council is looking for you. Matvey Shramov, one of their agents, wants to see you. You will find him at the Lake Tract, to the northeast of Novograd. Now get your butt in gear and go see him. Don't be late or they'll start searching for you themselves and you don't want that.
Did they send you from the capital? Fine. Pavel Isaev told me you have done well on Evermeet Isle. Now we need to find the roots of this mutiny...
Kill 4 Forest Agitators in Northern Birchwoods. Then return to Matvey Shramov.

To the north of Novograd there are two savage tribes - the Forestfolk and the Waterfolk. The League welcomes everyone who is willing to follow our laws and we are eager to build bridges. We've maintained a peaceful relationship with the Waterfolk, but we haven't been so lucky with the Forestfolk.

Now they're harassing the Waterfolk - calling them out for siding with us. Perhaps this will blow over and they'll stop eventually. Or perhaps not. Who knows?

At any rate, go north towards the White Lake and teach these agitators a good lesson. Four kills should be enough. Yes, kills - we need to send a clear message and there's no time to get all melodramatic.
Well? Have you taken care of those pesky agitators?
It's good to see that you're prepared to do any mission for the good of the League. There's a war going on and we don't always have time for diplomacy.
Kill 4 Gray Wolves and report to Anchut the Vigilant.

Looking for a new task? Great! That works out for the both of us since I have a bottomless box full of them. Let's fish one out...
Ah, a request from our northern neighbors the waterfolk. They're calling in regards to our arrangement to protect them from the wolves as per our treaty. Oh, my. They've ended the request with, "or else we'll dissolve the alliance and flood your town." How insolent they are!
You'll find the wolves in the forest to the north of here. These savages aren't capable of flooding anything, but treaties are to be respected. When you're done report to the waterfolk chief, Anchut. I'm sure he'll be glad to hear the news.
Aha! I see I scared you into coming! Good call. You're better off living in peace with us. Have you killed all of the wolves?

Really? All of them? Is there a way to check? Damnit, I should have ordered you to bring their fangs. Fangs would make counting their deaths easier. Or no, the pelts are better! They're useful as well! Hm, I suppose I'll ask for those things the next time around.
Collect 4 Squirrel Hides for Anchut the Vigilant.

About the hides. Well, if I'm not going to be getting any wolf pelts, let's turn our attention to the squirrels. Their fur is even better - it's so soft and warm!

You can find the squirrels to the north of here, in the area where those horrible Forestfolk live. Take care not to damage their hides! Bring me two... no, three... four hides! Yes, exactly four squirrel hides! If you don't, we'll flood your town. We can do anything, remember that!
Where are the hides? The hides, damn you! I should start flooding your town already!
Oh, how nice! So soft and furry! What a nice hat I'll make for myself! Just beautiful! I saw one on your ambassador and nearly burst with envy.

Put 4 Freshwater Pike Heads into the Empty Fisherman's Box. Dive into the lake and put the box down by the big snag on the bottom, between the bathhouse and the Waterfolk village. Wait for the lake monster to appear and kill it. Take the monster's head to Soti the Stinky.

Hey, there. Wait a second.

Why are you making a face? Yes, I smell, but I'm a fisherman. So I smell... like fish. That's the job.

It hurts... It also hurts that they are calling me a liar. I'm the only one who's seen the lake monster!

But it does exist! I saw it! It's huge! I call it Fangy 'cause it's got so many teeth.

I've only ever seen it when I'm fishing. It never shows up if you just sit on the shore and stare at the water. If you wanna fulfill my request, you've got to become a fisherman yourself.

Kill four fish and put their heads in this basket. Then place the basket in the water near the Waterfolk tribe, just to the south of the island. That's how we'll lure the monster out! At that point, it's all yours to deal with.
I must warn you, it's a horrible and evil beast.
If you do manage to kill it, bring me the monster's head. Let them see that Soti the Stinky ain't some kind of windbag. He's an honest fisherman!
What's that smell? It's like some sort of fish...

Oho! That's not too bad! What a handsome catch.
This feat, coupled with all your previous merits, warrants a reward.
Mark 4 Large Pine Trees and return to the Gray Family.

We are going to need new ships for further expeditions. The Farshore Shipyard is in short supply of timber already.
That's why we're sending you north. To the west of White Lake there some magnificent pines. They're perfect for our ship and they have not yet been reached by the lumberjacks. Find the tallest and the strongest of them and mark their trunks.
To do it, you'll need this shipbuilder's stamp. Take care not to lose it. We'll want it back when you're done. Please be quick about it - we don't want those Kanians to chop down all the trees for firewood before we can get them.
We're in great need of timber now. We need to build a new ship and set sail, hey ho!
Did you choose some good trees? You'd better be telling the truth. You too will have to use these ships, you know. Alright, alright. Well, thanks for your help.
Kill Broome the Terrible and return to Anchut the Vigilant.

Now let's talk seriously as representatives of two great nations. We're having a problem with the forestfolk, and the treaty says that my enemy is your enemy. The forestfolk chief is young and strong and we can't beat him.
What would we do if he came to us and destroyed our village? Who would you have a treaty with? If he takes our land he can flood your town too, I swear it.
You'll find him in the north of here - his name is Broome. Find him and kill him. When you return to me I'll give you a present and I'll promise not to flood your town. Deal?
Did you kill the forestfolk chief? I thought we made a deal!
I did well to make a treaty with the League. What a great benefit for both nations! Choose your reward and tell your people that everything will be all right, I shall not flood the town. I swear it!
Take the letter to the Detective Bureau.

The letter that was found on the rebel's corpse contains information pertaining to weapon caches in Southern Birchwoods. The late Danil Remizov was to announce that the weapons are ready to be sent to the rebels with the smoke signals. Danil states that the poison has been scattered around bee hives, and should everything go well Aidenus will soon be honey-poisoned to death.
This letter should be delivered to the Detective Bureau as soon as possible. It looks like it's a matter of national importance!
Oh, look at that smile on your face. Have you found something interesting?
I send you to deal with the forest agitators and you come back with this. What luck, and luck deserves a reward! But then again, I believe you deserved one anyway.
Speak with Bogdan Lyutikov near White Lake.

Who else should I notify of my husband's death? Zinoviy's no good - he's too old already... Denis, hm... No, he's too airheaded!
Bogdan! That's who I need. He's a thrifty and practical man and he's been living on the shore of White Lake for years just farming wild honey and brewing the world's best mead. Oh, what a great effect it will have on the inn if I marry Bogdan! We can sell his brew to the customers!
I have made my decision. Go to Bogdan on the eastern shore of White Lake. His house can be found near the rapids - you can't miss it. Tell him about my situation. I'm sure Bogdan will be sensitive to my plight.
You want to try my mead? No way - I've got exclusive contracts with bulk buyers! There is no retail on the premises.

Maya Korchakova? The innkeeper? Hm, it sounds mighty tempting. Although, I must admit that I heard Maya was a lady of most easy virtue... But who's without sin among us? You know what, I need to think about it.
Kill 4 Raging Bees and collect 4 Honeycombs for Bogdan Lyutikov.

Guests are a rare sight in these parts. It's a wild place and most people don't like the bees. They just don't know the right way to handle them. I've been making mead for years and I've only been stung once so far. Yesterday, as a matter of fact.
Now there's something strange - it's like my bees are different. Some of them have become very aggressive and won't let me approach the hives, and they sting! It's the honey gathering season now and I have a very important order from Aidenus himself. The Great Mage values my mead!
So, will you go out to the field and kill the aggressive bees and gather my honey? That'll be like killing two birds with one stone!
What's wrong with these bees? Attacking and withholding honey from me, their best friend! What in the world is going on?!
It's a shame that it had to come to this. I would normally never kill my lovely bees. Thank you for doing what was necessary and bringing me this honey.
Return to Maya Korchakova in Lightwood.

About the matter with Maya... I've thought it over. I came to the conclusion that married life just isn't for me. Having to move to town and run the inn... I'm an old bachelor, you know? I love solitude and nature. And the bees!
Convey my best wishes and express my regret to Maya. Tell her not to be offended - it's me, not her. I'm sure she'll understand.
How about it? Can I order my wedding gown yet?
What a shame! It could have been such a profitable marriage. Men! They don't realize how to find their own happiness and don't value the benefits of a woman's care!

Ah, so you're here about the rune!
Yes, I do have one for you. Here, take this. Thanks for the delivery!
Taste the honey and report to Bogdan Lyutikov.

Hey, hey, wait up! This honey is strange... it doesn't look right... Look, its color is all wrong and there are some weird lumps in it! I wonder what could have happened?
Listen, will you maybe... er, taste it? Hey, I don't like that look... Just try it, will ya? Don't worry, I have some strong medicines in my cabin if anything happens.
Come on, help yourself! It's probably fine and I'm just worrying for no reason.

Whoa, that's no honey! It's pure poison! How are you feeling? Will you live? That's good to hear. Hm, how can I make amends? Ah, take this! It's my very best mead! Oh, stop looking at me like that. I made this one some time ago. I've tasted it myself, it's a dream!
Find the campsite in the eastern mountains.

What lowlife scattered poison across the field? That's the only explanation for the mad bees and the toxic honey. It can be nothing but poison!
I saw some black smoke to the southeast recently. Not many people would set up camp there. It must be the lowlifes! Those bastards.
Their campfire must have been set on the mountainside. I roughly know the area - there's a path leading up the mountainside to the south. There's a small plateau at the top and it would make a great site for a camp.
Go there and see who they are, what they want, and why they scattered the poison. They have to be behind this, I'm sure of it!
Who are you? What do you want here?
Praise Tensess! It seems that the Light has taken mercy on me and has granted me a way to make amends.
Kill 4 Mutineers and Danil Remizov in the eastern part of Northern Birchwoods. Report to Pavel Isaev in Novograd.

Our time is short so I won't bore you with the details. Let's just say that I was stupid to get mixed up with the rebels. The longer I've been with them, the clearer it has become that this was a wrong choice. Carnage, violence, murder! That's not the path for Kania to follow.
They've sent me here to maintain the signal fire. Before that, they had me scattering poison in the fields. I have no idea why, but what I do know is that Danil Remizov has to be stopped. That's our leader's name - he's a cruel man. Like all the others in that gang.
Go downhill and kill Danil and his henchmen. I feel that their death will mean life for a good deal of innocent people. When you're finished, go into Novograd immediately and tell them about this gang. The rebellion must be put down!
And one important note: I noticed Danil was reading a letter, trying to attract little attention. It looked important to him, maybe it contains important information on the mutiny.
Danil's gang? I've heard the name - a cruel and reckless guy, with many a crime on his record. If he's dead... well, that's good news.
Collect Wreckage from the ship wreck to the west of Novograd and return to the Gray Family.

We just learned from the Detective Bureau that a ship tried to enter the bay but the rebels inside Oreshek Fortress shot it down. We were the ones that set up the cannons in the fortress! Those bastards, using our work to take down a perfectly good ship...
That ship may be a Gibberling one - quite possibly one of the scouting ships sent to search for our Isa. However, we don't know which one it was or what news it was bringing.
Can you go to shore to the west of Novograd and check it out? Maybe there's something useful there, some fragments or papers that could tell us about it. We're in need of any information now.
Have you found anything? We have a feeling the ship is important - that it's carrying good news.

"...ABLE TUB..." What was that ship? Oh! That's the "Unsinkable Tub"! We saw her off ourselves! What an unlucky day it's been... What if the scouts had found our homeland and were sailing back with good news? Damn those rebels! We'll have to organize a new expedition now...
Speak with Timofey Gromov about Maya Korchakova.

What should I do? I'm panicking now. How can I live without a husband? People will make fun of me.
Now Tikhomir is my only hope. Oh, Holy Tensess, he's such an able man, such a comprehending one! He's a doctor and he knows the human body like the back of his hand.
But he's out in town thanks to that rebellion. They've sent my love to the frontline - he's the infirmary chief there. Will you hurry to tell him that I'm waiting, longing, and hoping? The field hospital is in the south, quite near the frontline. Tell my love that there's a warm heart waiting for him in town.
What do you have? Diarrhea? Tuberculosis? This is no place for kids, there's a war going on here.
What? Who the heck is Zaya? The innkeeper? Damn, I knew I shouldn't have taken the last mug. Alright, the diagnosis is clear - now to come up with the cure.
Collect 4 pieces of Bear Fat for Timofey Gromov.

Since you're here, you might as well help us out. We're running low on balm, and that's something that we can't do without right now. It's an essential remedy for healing the soldiers. Fortunately, the base for the balm is plain old fat. The bears around here have put on some weight, so if you're going into the forest anyway, can you please bring me four pieces of bear fat?

Well, what are you waiting for? I'm not giving you any anesthetic. Just give the beasts a swift death, and by the time you're cutting off their fat the bears won't need it any more. So why waste it?
What did I send you after again? Fat or mold? Fat? Okay, so where is it?
Great! Show it to me. Oh, that's good fat. This will do nicely! Have you been battered by the bears? Here, take this - it might come in handy.
Collect 4 drops of Bee Poison and take them to Timofey Gromov.

To ease the suffering of the injured we create some special compounds. We rub them into their skin before we work on their wounds. Unfortunately, we don't have enough supplies to keep up with the number of wounded soldiers coming into the camp.

The main ingredient is a simple one - apitoxin, or bee poison. Collect four drops of apitoxin and bring them to me.
Sometimes poison turns to be a valuable cure, everything depends on the dose.
Thanks for the poison! Ha, sounds funny when you say it.
Speak with Feodor Baskov in Amberwood.

Let's talk about our lady innkeeper. I have no intention of becoming her husband or even explaining my reasons for refusal. However, I do know how to help the merry widow.
The evening that I last set eyes upon her I had a drinking companion, a hunter by the name of Feodor Baskov. He was a widower himself, and the innkeeper took a fancy to him.
Go to him and explain the situation. You can find him at the hunters' camp in Amberwood, just to the south of Novograd. I'm sure Feodor will be happy to hear about the innkeeper's search.
Now you'll be able to make three people happy - the innkeeper, the hunter, and yourself. I bet you're sick and tired of running all around Lightwood trying to find her a potential husband.
What is it that you need?
Maya? Of course I remember her. She's a very nice lady - so practical yet caring. Oh... you say she's become a widow? What does that have to do with me?
Visit the Field Hospital and speak with sergeant Jean de Blizare.

There you are - I've been waiting for you. I've received a letter from the Elven District where your name was mentioned. They are interested in your story of a mysterious wizard who helped to leave the Evermeet Isle. Sergeant Jean de Blizare is investigating this matter, meet him at the Field Hospital, not far from here.

We need to discuss your recent adventures on that mysterious allod. As far as we know, you happened to meet an Elven Archmage there who chose to remain incognito. It is him we'll be talking about. In the mean time, here is the reward you were promised.
How interesting! Invitation to the Great Ball. From your own hands! It is a truly lucky day today.
h: Pass the Invitation to the Great Ball

t:
We're still hunting the bandits in local forests and mountains.

We destroyed the biggest gangs ten years ago, with your help, but some petty bandits are left. We're hunting them down. We'd finish them, but the war is always in our way. You know, the demons, the architects...

Over the last year, the bandits have been receiving help from outside the allod. Someone brings smuggled weapons, puts in stashes on the shore, and quietly leaves. We don't have enough ships to patrol the whole place.

I'll set up a great manhunt after the Great Ball. The new gang, the Rats, are a pain in merchants' neck. I need to chase the rats down and execute them.
h: What are you up to? What are you doing in Lightwood?

t: First and foremost, we are looking out for the League's best interests! We also look after the interests of elves and our own House.
Search for Antoine de Vevre in the Southern Birchwoods.

This mysterious person's identity is of great interest to us. It will be a waste of both yours and ours to explain the reasons. Perhaps some other time...
We have several theories regarding the Nautilus' owner and we'd like your insight. One possible candidate is an Elven wizard of the de Ardeur House. We have not heard from him for many years. It's normal for us - an Elf is entitled to his or her solitude. However recent events have compelled us into finding our missing Elves. The latest piece of information to come to us about this wizard, Antoine, concerns his dwelling as a hermit in the Southern Birchwoods. We are asking you to go there and find out what happened to him after that.
Of course, all your efforts will be rewarded.
Are you ready to come to our aid?
Don't kill me, okay? I'll spill the beans, I swear!
Who are you lookin' for? That Elf wizard? ‘Course I know him! A calm guy, right? I wish all the Elves were like him.
Speak with Jean de Desirae about Antoine's fate.

So it's like this, our gang's been livin' in this forest for a long time and we've become somewhat of a local legend. We even hit it off with the Elf - he didn't hurt us and we didn't hurt him. Sure, I guess it's dangerous to try and hurt him, him being a wizard and all.
Then some new gang appeared - the one that seized the Big Stones. Those guys were reckless, the Bloody Avengers - now that's a name! Some of our guys even abandoned us for them. These Avengers attacked the wizard and dragged him off to the quarries. Why? No idea. But the Elf isn't here anymore, so we decided to move in. Then you come in like a bolt from the Astral...
Don't kill me, please. Go into town, see the Elves, and tell them all ‘bout the Wizard. They're his kin, after all, maybe they'll take care of him.

Two things can be concluded from your story. First, Antoine de Vevre is not your mysterious "N." He could not be fighting off the bandits and helping you on that allod simultaneously.
The second conclusion is that our interference is required.
Collect 2 Wolf Hides and 2 Boar Hides for Rada Svetlova.

Hey, you can help me! Ever heard of the Bare Minimum Trading Post?
It's a very reputable organization! A monopoly, so to speak! They're always trying to take everyone's business. Give them a little time and even the Steeler Weapons Guild might give in.
So, what does a sensible Kanian do in this situation? That's right - he keeps his nose to the wind. That's why I decided to join the crew - I like being with winners.
I'm on my seventh investment now and they're looking for animal hides. Can you help?
Boars and wolves will do - you can find them in the birch forest to the south of here. But finding them ain't the problem - skinning them is. Rest assured that I will have a reward ready for you - the best potions I've got! And maybe even a little something extra too.
Where are my hides? The deadline to make the deposit is close!

Excellent! Two rewards, as promised. The first is a potion I made myself.
And the second one is - you can join our crew! The member's fee you have to make, the "bare minimum," is not hides or even precious stones - its people! You bring ten more crew members with you, and then a portion of their fees will be yours. So, first you bring ten friends, they brings their friends... a few more hundred people and you'll be rich! C'mon, join us! Are you gonna sign up?
Ah, that's a shame... You're missing out on an opportunity of a lifetime!
Find and mark 3 weapon caches. Report back to Goryana Izerskaya at the Field Hospital.

This situation with the hidden weapons requires our immediate attention. We can't allow the weapons to fall into the rebels' hands and destroying them would be wasteful. We'd rather gather them for ourselves.
This operation will require some serious preparation. Thankfully our agents from the Council are up to the job. Here, take this signal beacon. Go to the Southern Birchwoods and find the hidden weapon caches.
Use the signal beacon to mark their location and members of the Council will pick them up later. Please return once you're finished so that I can assign you your next task.
How do you like the gadgets our agents make? They're quite good, aren't they.
Good. Now we have one less problem to worry about.
Search for Antoine de Vevre near Big Stones.

We can't allow bandits to kidnap Elves - it completely undermines our authority.
Go to the quarries and find Antoine de Vevre. If he is still alive, of course. As for the "N" puzzle, we'll come back to it later, once we're done with this current task.
Did you find any information on the whereabouts of the Elven wizard?
An Elven mage? My, of course I've seen him. Something really interesting happened to him.
Tell Pierre de Desirae that Antoine de Vevre has been taken to Oreshek Fortress.

The rebels that took the Elf guy? Oh yes, the ones who seized Oreshek. They paid a handsome fee to the bandits for him - I heard they were taking him to Oreshek. There's nothing good that we can expect to come of that. The bastards must be up to some kind of a mean trick if they need a wizard like him. Go back to the capital and tell them the news. As for me, I'll be trying to make my exit too. One of us will surely make it back to the capital.

Glad to finally meet you.
Do you have something urgent to tell me? Tell me.

An Elven wizard in rebel hands? And there's no way to avoid informing the Detective Bureau. What a disgrace...
This cannot go on. We cannot permit the great art of magic to serve some degenerates. We have a new mission for you and a reward for your efforts.
Kill 4 bandits in the southern stone quarry. Report to the Gray Family in Novograd.

We have some trouble raining from the clouds over Kania lately.

The rebels have seized Oreshek and some newly-arrived bandits took the Big Stones, which is where our meteoritic iron is mined. Our plans to build Astral ships have been jeopardized. They can't sail without meteorites, can they? And there is no one to send to clear the quarries, all the men are on the frontline. If only...

Listen, if there is anyone who can cope with the bandits, it's you. The Big Stones quarries are south of the Southern Birchwoods, the road leads straight to them.

Go there and regain control of the quarries! If you succeed, report to Novograd gibberlings, they've been waiting for the meteorite supplies for too long.
Can we start sending miners to the quarries yet?
Hurray! We'll be digging up even more meteoritic ore now!
Use the Primordial Stone to subdue 3 Boulder Elementals. Report to Michelle de Grandeur.

At last! Someone has come to clear the quarry of these bandits! You'll help me, won't you? I've got a great plan that should make this easy.
You see, I was originally sent to this quarry in order to oversee the work of the earth elementals. Unfortunately, when they were attacked by the bandits, my binding spell broke.
This Primordial Stone can make them submit to your will. It's something they were made from, and so it holds power over them. However, before they succumb to it you'll have to weaken them first. Only then will the Primordial Stone work.
Once we control the earth elementals, we can tell them to attack the bandits. Then those bastards will wish they had never come here!
It's time to clear the quarries of this trash!
Perfect. Now I have a force that can drive those ruffians from the quarries. I can shift for myself now. This should be fun!
Kill Boris Seversky and report to Pavel Isaev.

Attention, attention!
By order of the Detective Bureau the dangerous leader of the Bloody Avengers gang, Mr. Boris Seversky, is sentenced to death according to martial law.
The sentence should be carried out in the southern region of Big Stones where the convict is hiding. The executioner's efforts will be well compensated.
Any hero that completes this task should report directly to the Detective Bureau for their reward.
What do you want to tell me? Anything of importance?
Well then, that's one less problem. I believe this merits a reward.
Collect 4 Wolf Heads and bring them to Maya Korchakova as a gift from Feodor Baskov.

Oh, I don't even know...
She's an innkeeper, a woman of fashion. And me, I'm just a loner. How could she like a man like me?
Eh... Though, on the other hand... I've hunted wolves and bears - I've even seen a dragon once... After that, how hard dealing with a skirt could be?
 We've got to give her a present of some kind. To make her see that I'm reliable, brave, and... er, always able to earn my living, you know. There's one problem. The wolves. Usually the military deals with them - I don't know if I could manage to kill one myself.
But you could. What do you say? Would you help this lonely old man to find love? The local wolves are pretty vicious. But that's what makes the gift better. Kill four of them and bring their heads to the innkeeper. And... tell her that they're from me, alright?
She'll surely reward you. Trust me, I know them women.
Finally! Tell me - have you found a husband for me?

Wolf heads... he couldn't think up something better? I remember him - a wild man, he smelled of the forest and blood. Not my type at all. I'm a subtle and fastidious lady.
Sigh, it seems like I shall have to grow old alone. I've got no more candidates. Thank you, I guess. Not for finding me a husband, but for helping to get rid of my phantoms. Take this reward for your efforts.
Talk to Andre de Desirae in the Dead Thicket.

There's another investigation that simply cannot wait. There are a group of werewolves that have migrated to the southeast of Novograd. In light of all the other events that have occurred recently, this seems quite suspicious. I already sent an agent to investigate the situation, but he hasn't reported back yet.
I would like your help with this investigation. This business with the werewolves could be another thread of the dark web that is spreading over the League.
The agent's name is Andre de Desirae and you should be able to find him in the Dead Thicket, near a camp of hunters. Please help him out in any way you can. Good luck!
What do you want? I have a lot to do.
I don't have much to report yet. This case is a rather difficult one.
Kill 4 Werewolves and report to Andre de Desirae.

As yet, I've managed to find out little - shape shifters do exist, and they're quite ferocious. Their reasons, motives, aims, and goals are unclear. I suspect they are connected to the rebels, but the nature of this connection or the mutual advantage of their cooperation is not yet clear.
My current plan is to eliminate them. Yes, simply killing those bastards until the truth emerges by itself. A standard method, proven to be fruitful more than once.
You can help our efforts if you'd like. The more shape shifters we kill, the faster we can solve this case and finally return to Novograd where we may find a better use for our talents.
Have you dealt with the werewolves?
Good job! I've always known that old, time-tested methods are the best solutions in most situations.
Meet Vakula in the Dead Thicket.

Look what I've received - a letter on birch bark. Written in blood, according to these bastards' custom, eh. In essence, it's a formal challenge to a duel.
Someone, undersigning as Vakula, demands to meet our... hm... ‘representative' in order to solve some, hm, ‘matters of controversy' once and for all. That isn't what's written here, of course, but I'm not going to utter these rude words and vulgarities.
The meeting is to take place in the remote portion of the Dead Thicket to the southeast of here. Could you use another reward? If so, meet him there and show his kind that we will not be trifled with.
The best thing you can do right now is beat it. You'd better don't cross my path when I'm angry.
What?! You accept my challenge?! Grr... that's just ridiculous! This world is clearly going mad!
Defeat Vakula and report back to the Detective Bureau.

Listen up. We don't want to hurt you - we just want to be left alone to live quietly in the woods. As soon we moved in there was a Kanian already knocking on our door.
Grr. White bones and blue blood - I hate him! He's been coming around and offering me some "treaty," promising to allow us a free pass in your town for three days. He's got some nerve!
So I told him no. All my pack needs is a dark forest and prey. This place suits our needs perfectly, but your kind keeps disturbing us! That's why I've come up with a way to solve the matter - a duel between you and me.
Whoever wins is right. You win and my brothers will elect a new leader and leave this place. But if I bite and you die, then this forest is ours. So, are you up for the challenge?
I hope the Dead Thicket problem has been dealt with?

I recall the day you first appeared at our headquarters with gratitude. In addition to the Dead Thicket being cleansed of filth, we've also made another smidgen of truth clear.
The nobles, eh... Yes, for some people, the changes in Kania are not to their liking, some are displeased with our alliance with the Elves and Gibberlings. Never mind, we'll stamp these dregs out.
Kill 2 Mountain Adders and 2 Mountain Rattlers and report to Pakhom Rogov.

Let's return to the tasks at hand, shall we? One of Lightwood's strategic locations is the Farshore Shipyard on the western coast. The rebels tried to seize the shipyard but we managed to hold it.
However, there are still some problems there - the chief shipwright reports that the surrounding area is crawling with snakes, and frequent attacks have jeopardized supplies of timber to the shipyard. I need an agent to go out there and take care of this problem as soon as possible.

A full sail and the Astral sea... A wind that always follows me...
Like watching ships being built, too? An excellent sight!
Fine. Both City Council and Construction council express their gratitude to you.
Kill the Runaway Unicorn and return to the Husky Family.

We regret ever getting involved in this risky venture with the zoo! We've spent many years traveling the world, catching rare beasts and risking our lives. The idea was to start a zoo in Novograd - it promised to be a profitable business.
But now everything is bursting at the seams! Our ship was damaged by the rebels, we barely made it to the shore, and to make matters worse, an explosion damaged the cages. Our beasts escaped into the woods! The money's all gone and we're in a great deal of trouble!
One of the escaped animals is a wild unicorn that we suspect is seeking refuge near Adder Plateau. Please help us - find the bastard and kill it before it makes any trouble for the locals.
We hope you have good news. Is the unicorn dead?
Good. One less problem to worry about.
Collect 4 measures of Sticky Spider Saliva for the Lame Family.

At this rate you and I can build a whole Astral ship in no time! We've found the timber and cleared the quarries. Now all we need is to get some shipbuilders.
Speaking of ships... The saliva of the spiders inhabiting the Adder Plateau area has proven useful in sealing the seams. That's something we can never have too much of!
Find the spider lair in the mountains and collect four measures of spider saliva. Take it to the Lame Family in Farshore Shipyard. It'll be their birthday soon, so we can kill two birds with one stone - please the old man and deliver the ships faster.
"Anchors aweigh, my boys, anchors aweigh. Farewell to childhood joys..." Hm... Yeah?
Spider saliva! A perfect gift for a shipbuilder! That means we can launch her soon - exactly on our birthday. We'll throw such a party!
Speak with the Obtuse Family at Farshore Shipyard.

Our main task now is to understand why the rebels need Antoine de Vevre. Damn, I wish there was a way I could avoid going through all of the official procedures.
Wait, I know! There were some Gibberling psionicists among the rebels. League soldiers captured him during a rebel attack on the Farshore Shipyard, but the Gibberlings always stick up for their own kind. He is being kept there in their custody, awaiting punishment indefinitely.
Perhaps they can repay their sins by using their abilities and knowledge of the rebels to help us out. Go to the shipyard and convince them to help us out. We need to know why they kidnapped the Elven Archmage!
We're not inclined to chatter. In fact, we have been forbidden to talk to anyone until we understand the importance of our mistakes.

Ah, so you're here on business. It's okay, we already know why you're here. We realized we're just players in a larger game - merely pawns, so to speak. It's kind of a shame too...
It was just beginning to get interesting - a rebellion, an uprising, a revolution! It was romantic, damnit!
Collect 4 Astral Gems for the Obtuse Family.
We need those delicious little gifts from the Astral!
Well, let's do it. I must admit I've never tried this before, and my teacher once told me it can be very dangerous... Oh, the pressure... Myyyy bbbrraiinnn!
Report the rebel plans to the Detective Bureau.

I doubt I'll ever dare to use those crystals again...
This is what I found out. The rebels need the wizard in order to open the portal to Igsh. Through it, Imperial troops will arrive, do away with our army, and seize the capital. Dreadful, isn't it? The rebellion and the seizure of Oreshek was all for that purpose and funded by the Empire. Oh, if only I had known that before...
The Elf's still holding out, resisting, but... they're torturing him. I have seen submission in his mind - they've almost crushed his will.
If we don't save the wizard, Lightwood will drown in blood... League blood. Run to the Detective Bureau. Tell them to start the assault at once. And I... I will need some rest. A hundred days, I think.

What?!
So this is the answer, the center of the cobweb. And that is the spider... the Empire. Our eternal enemy and all this story is but another page in story of our conflict.
Use the Brainwave Reader on a bat to create its mental copy. Do that 3 more times. Bring the copies to Bernard de Blizare.

The purpose of my stay here is to upgrade the Astral ships.
I have managed to use snake skin to stabilize the power supply to the reactor, increasing its efficiency by 0.7%. Boar intestines became a key component of ropes.
Yes, I prefer to use natural resources. I take a position close to that of the druids - nature has already invented everything, we only need to find the way to adapt it to our needs.
I'm studying bats right now. These animals are able to find their way in darkness, and maybe that can be a solution for ship navigation during Astral storms.
I use a special apparatus to study this natural phenomena. I call it the Brainwave Reader. I use it on the target creature from afar to create a mental copy of the creature as it was before the time of death, in a natural state, rather than under stress. Go to the coast and collect four mental copies for me. Remember to use the Brainwave Reader on them before you fight them! Working for the advancement of science pays well.
My research has been delayed! And it's all because of your sluggishness!

Very well. I will start my research immediately. There must be a way for our ships to navigate through a storm.
Here's your reward. Take it, take it, there's a whole lot more where that came from!
Use the Scroll of Soothing Thoughts to calm three panicking workers. Report back to the Lame Family.

So I now have the run of you? By the Astral, I never thought they'd send a real agent to help little old me. I'd have made some preparations if I had known, devised a dangerous mission for you or something. Wait...
There is a problem! When the rebels attacked, most of our workers got so frightened that they scattered all over the shipyard. If it was my Gibberling crew we could've coped with the enemy without the guards but you can't expect anything from those Kanian peasants, especially since there were psionicists among the attackers. They're right over there - I chose not to send them to the prison. They're some of ours after all - Gibberlings. They just got involved in the wrong crowd - they're young and stupid. No reason to ruin their lives. Besides, they've already shown repentance. They've made a scroll to be used for removing their spell. Take that scroll all over the shipyard and set these peasants right.
Oh, what are we to do?! The work has stopped, the workers are running around in a panic, and the Empire's ships are out on the Astral Sea as we speak!

Atta boy! The loafers are back to work. Hammers knocking, cables creaking... Soon enough a new ship will be launched and sail towards the unknown.
"We be three Astral wayfarers..."
